title: Vanish Input
author: Rauno Freiberg

fresh_visual_review.method: Every original frame visually inspected in18 ordered full-canvas contact sheets at300px wide, plus3 native-resolution particle keys. No fps resampling.

assignment: Unassigned conditional candidate; root tentatively holds036 but has not assigned an owner

observations.behavior: Focused dark search field and placeholder, blue caret blinks.
First three-word phrase is typed, left aligned, no submit button in field.

Return-key overlay appears below field. Rightmost glyphs break into many small white particles, then a right-to-left front consumes the remaining text; particles jitter and spread horizontally/rightward while fading. Search icon, input boundary and caret remain.
Empty field hold with caret; Return overlay holds.
Second phrase typed. Return overlay fades/shrinks during typing.
Second right-to-left particle wipe. Return overlay returns.
Third particle wipe, same direction and thin vertical envelope.
Fourth phrase typed; initially caret ends after text.
Keyboard visualizer shows Command then Command+Left. Caret jumps to the START of existing phrase and blinks there; text is not deleted by the shortcut. Keyboard overlay then fades.
Return-key visualizer appears and fourth wipe still runs RIGHT TO LEFT despite caret staying at the START. This late state is important.
Empty field with caret and Return overlay.
Placeholder fades back in while Return overlay fades/scales out.
Final empty focused field; caret continues blinking. No fifth submission.

recommendation: Conditional: high-quality programmable glyph-to-particle deletion, but the recorded sample text is a12-word lyric excerpt. Use independently written preview text; this changes literal source text matching and must be accepted explicitly by coordinator before assigning.
limits: Do not reproduce the complete recorded song lyric in code/docs/previews. Independently written phrases can match the four-cycle interaction and approximate line widths.
Particle motion is independent glyph sampling plus short horizontal jitter/fade; no source raster or point texture should be copied.
Four submits constitute one example, not four variants.
The final Command+Left and start-caret submission must be included, not cut off after first dissolve.
No per-post X URL verified; public author page and author-hosted footage are primary provenance.
Source footage remains local analysis only; no redistribution license identified.
